title: Viewport stitching and scroll-lock parity for dashboard panels, charts, and modals
creator: Maya Chen
description: Improve the Console surface behavior where panels, charts, tables and modals interact with viewport changes across browsers and device sizes. Goals: 1) eliminate transient gaps and visual jumps when panels stack or unstack during viewport resize or keyboard appearance on mobile; 2) provide consistent scroll-lock and focus-trap behavior for nested modals and rollout flyouts; 3) ensure charts and tables reflow without losing selections or hover state; 4) produce a robust cross-browser fallback strategy for browsers that do not fully support position:sticky, CSS containment, or transform-based stacking contexts.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard panels should reflow smoothly at breakpoints without 1-3px seams or sudden content jumps on Chrome, Firefox, Safari (macOS/iOS) and Edge
Opening a modal or rollout panel must lock background scroll on mobile and desktop while preserving keyboard and screen-reader focus order
Chart hover states and table row selection persist through viewport snaps and when a KV-cache info flyout opens and closes
Graceful visual fallback when position:sticky is unsupported: sticky region collapses to a fixed header with animation under 150ms
Design tokens and spacing scales used by engineering match the final handoff vars (spacing.xs..xl, z-index layers: base/tools/overlay)
design_notes: Prefer transform-based translateY for small adaptive slides to avoid layout thrash on Safari; fallback to top/left for older WebKit with a progressive enhancement comment
Use CSS containment: layout in high-cost charts to avoid repaint storms; limit will-change usage to transient interactions only
Stacking context plan: establish a documented z-index ladder: base(0), surface(100), panel(200), modal(400), toast(600) to avoid ad-hoc overrides in feature PRs
Introduce an affordance for native keyboard appearance on iOS: add -webkit-overflow-scrolling tuning + a 56px keyboard-safe inset for pinned controls
Trade-off: using position:fixed for sticky fallbacks increases paint but simplifies focus trapping; chosen as fallback only for iOS 15 and older
comments: 2026-01-28 Maya Chen: Initial ticket created after hallway testing showed inconsistent modal background scrolling on iOS when the keyboard appears. Captured first-pass gaps in figma and a quick prototype.

2026-02-03 Liam O'Connor: Exploratory prototype implemented using transform-translateY for panel slides. Observed better frame rates in Chrome but slight jitter on Safari when nested overflow containers present.
2026-02-15 Priya Rao (PM): Scoped to include cost-view tables and rollout flyouts since those flows are blocking a customer pilot. Added ENG-7241 as dependency for runtime telemetry hooks.
2026-02-22 Design crit: Recommend limiting will-change to tokenized components and prefer containment on chart canvases. Agreed to add a test matrix for Safari iOS 15/16, macOS Ventura, Firefox 115+.

2026-03-01 Engineering review (Anita Gupta): Implemented sticky fallback with a 120ms cross-fade; raised concern about repaint causing latency on low-end devices. Action: add a low-power media query to reduce animation complexity.
2026-03-05 Accessibility review (Diego Morales): Focus trap behavior verified for two-level modal stacks; requested aria-hidden toggles and live-region announcements when rollouts change state.
2026-03-09 Liam O'Connor: Updated handoff with token names and added CSS snippets (see attachment). Added small-screen keyboard-safe insets and test notes for automated visual diffing.
2026-03-10 Maya Chen: Marking In Review. Please review Figma frames and the implementation PR. QA checklist attached — requesting design + accessibility sign-off before merge.
dev_hand_off: Provided a component-level spec: PanelShell accepts props: anchor(side), sticky(true|fallback), keyboardSafeInset(px), stackingLevel(enum). Included CSS utility classes and token variables. Recommended approach: use IntersectionObserver to toggle CSS class that switches between transform and fixed fallback; document performance impact in PR. Include visual-diff snapshots for 320/375/768/1280 widths across browsers.
qa_notes: Run visual-diff on Chrome(Desktop), Firefox(mac), Safari(mac), Safari(iOS 15/16) at listed widths; verify no seams when resizing between breakpoints
Validate background scroll is locked when modal opens and restored on close even when keyboard is active on mobile
Check table row selection persists after opening/closing a KV-cache flyout and after orientation change on mobile
Accessibility: keyboard trap, focus return, aria-hidden toggles, and live region announcements must pass manual check
rollout_plan: Canary rollout behind feature flag 'viewport-stitch-v1' for 5% traffic on staging and 1% on production for accounts using cost dashboards. Monitor error budget and frontend CPU spikes. Auto rollback threshold: 5% visual-diff failures or 2x increase in client-side rendering latency for cohort. Post-launch: 1-week telemetry check and collect UX notes for improvements.
